description: This file defines a custom React hook called useTicTacToe that manages the state and actions for a Tic Tac Toe game. It handles game state, move history, and provides handlers for user interactions like clicking squares, resetting, and undoing moves.

methods.name: useTicTacToe()
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages Tic Tac Toe game state, including history, current step, current player, winner, draw state, and provides methods to handle gameplay actions.
